label: Executive / Investor / Advisor
description: I need to understand the business concept and strategic value.
language: business value, outcomes, competitive differentiation. No technical terms.

label: Product Manager / Designer
description: I need to understand what it does and how it affects users.
language: user experience, product surfaces, what users see and do.

label: Engineer / Technical Builder
description: I need to understand the architecture in detail.
language: full technical detail, architecture boundaries, inputs/outputs, lifecycle.

label: New Team Member
description: I'm just getting started and want the big picture.
language: simple analogies, relatable examples, no assumed knowledge.

label: I just want to explore
description: Take me to the full system.
language: balanced — plain language with technical detail available on demand.
